notes: *Whereupon* could be headed on the preposition as the governing morpheme; the interrogative carries content the preposition lacks, so rule 23's content test decides it, matching rule 22's heading of a fused pronominal adverb on the wh-morpheme.

The fused `עַל` + `מָה` unit was re-tested against rule 30's one-English-word condition: the single word carries both the relation and the interrogative and neither morpheme owns a part of it, so the grouping is retained.
Both margins (*sockets*, *made to sink*) were read and set aside (rule 38).
